enchant_guidance.label: Should Feral Druid Tank Choose Aldor or Scryer for BiS in TBC Classic Phase 1?
enchant_guidance.text: Unlike most other specs in TBC, the choice of Aldor versus Scryer faction has almost zero impact on the long-term PvE performance of a Feral Druid. For bear tanks, the only permanently relevant items provided by these factions are the two shoulder enchants for threat and avoidance, respectively. The Aldor threat enchant is , and the Scryer version is , both of which require Exalted reputation with the Aldor and Scryer factions, respectively. Despite providing different distributions of Attack Power versus Critical Strike Rating, calculations show that both enchants provide nearly identical TPS value within current modeling accuracy.

enchant_guidance.label: Should Feral Druid Tank Choose Aldor or Scryer for BiS in TBC Classic Phase 1?
enchant_guidance.text: For mitigation, the Aldor faction offers  at Exalted reputation while the Scryers offer . Due to the way that Blizzard scaled rating stats in TBC, it turns out that 1 Defense Rating and 1 Dodge Rating provide an identical average reduction of DTPS (damage taken per second). So, just like the DPS enchants, the two enchant options provide the same average mitigation value, as they simply trade  5 Dodge Rotation for 5 Defense Rating. In practice, there are situations where you are just under the crit immunity cap and the extra 5 Defense Rating from the Scryer version would make up the difference, but there are also situations where your gear choices force you to be slightly above the cap, in which case the Aldor version would let you drop that extra Defense Rating efficiently. You cannot predict ahead of time exactly which of these scenarios may apply, since the order in which you acquire gear in a given raid tier is random, so just don't worry about it. In any case, these avoidance enchants only become relevant from late Phase 3 onwards when the passive avoidance on feral gear is high enough to prioritize avoidance stacking -  is a superior survivability enchant until then.
